entities.name: Headquarters of the French Communist Party
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The headquarters of the French Communist Party are located at 2 Place du Colonel Fabien in the 19th arrondissement of Paris. The lead architect was Oscar Niemeyer, who had previously designed many buildings for Brazil's new capital of Brasília.
